package.description: Multi tab terminal services/remote desktop client.

en-US.description: Multi tab terminal services/remote desktop client.
en-US.longDescription: Terminals is a secure, multi tab terminal services/remote desktop client. RDP, VNC, VMRC, SSH, Telnet, RAS, ICA Citrix, HTTP and HTTPs based protocols are integrated. It uses Terminal Services ActiveX Client (mstscax.dll). The project started from the need of controlling multiple connections simultaneously. It is a complete replacement for the mstsc.exe (Terminal Services) client.
en-US.name: Terminals

zh-CN.description: 多标签页终端服务/远程桌面客户端。
zh-CN.longDescription: Terminals 是一款安全的多标签页终端服务/远程桌面客户端，集成了 RDP、VNC、VMRC、SSH、Telnet、RAS、ICA Citrix 以及基于 HTTP 和 HTTPS 的协议。该软件采用 Terminal Services ActiveX 客户端（mstscax.dll）技术，其开发初衷源于同时管理多个连接的需求，可完全替代 mstsc.exe（终端服务）客户端。
